WITH transaction_mixes AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, 'MISSING') as mix,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  GROUP BY COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, 'MISSING')
),
summary AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count) as total_count,
    COUNT(*) as distinct_mixes
  FROM transaction_mixes
)
SELECT 
  tm.mix,
  tm.count,
  CAST(tm.count AS REAL) / s.total_count as share,
  CAST(tm.count AS REAL) / s.total_count - 1.0 / s.distinct_mixes as above_average
FROM transaction_mixes tm
CROSS JOIN summary s
WHERE CAST(tm.count AS REAL) / s.total_count > 1.0 / s.distinct_mixes
ORDER BY share DESC;
